title: Crypto Profit Calculator
description: Calculate profit, loss and ROI on any crypto trade with buy/sell fees included.
howto: Enter the buy price, sell price and amount of coins/tokens.
Add the exchange fee percentages for buying and selling.
Read your net profit or loss and ROI.

faqs.a: Buy fees increase your cost basis; sell fees reduce your proceeds. Both are deducted before profit is computed.
Return on investment = net profit ÷ total invested (including buy fees), as a percent.
No. Crypto-to-crypto trades and sales may be taxable events in your country — consult a tax professional.
